设计意图： Refinement of C301_B3_breakout_hold_confirm_001. The core mechanism is unchanged: a close above the prior 20-day high, two subsequent holds at that resistance, and breakout-day close-location/volume multipliers. The implementation is leaner by constructing the fixed resistance directly as max(high[t-22..t-3]) via high.shift(3).rolling(20).max(), eliminating the separate prior-high shift and second

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 resistance：high.shift(3).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).max()
  2. 计算 breakout：(close.shift(2) > resistance).astype(float)
  3. 计算 hold1：(close.shift(1) >= resistance).astype(float)
  4. 计算 hold2：(close >= resistance).astype(float)
  5. 计算 confirmed：breakout * hold1 * hold2
  6. 计算 close_loc：((close - low) / (high - low))
  7. 计算 volume_confirm：(volume.shift(2) > volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).median().shift(2)).astype(float)
  8. 计算 hold_dist：((close - resistance) / resistance)
  9. 计算 factor：confirmed * hold_dist * close_loc.shift(2) * volume_confirm
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_breakout_hold_confirmation_20d_refined(df): """Idea: A close above the prior 20-day high, followed by two sessions holding that resistance, confirms supply absorption; the signal is stronger when the breakout day closed ">class="kw">in the upper part of its range ">class="kw">and volume was above its 20-day median. Logic: The breakout resistance is built directly as the trailing 20-day high of high shifted three bars, so a single series represents the fixed resistance "kw">class="kw">for the breakout bar "kw">class="kw">and the two hold bars. The confirmed-breakout mask multiplies the percentage hold distance by the breakout-day close location "kw">class="kw">and the breakout-day above-median volume flag. This preserves the parent mechanism "kw">class="kw">while removing redundant shift operations on the prior-high series. Sub-mechanism tags: breakout, hold-confirmation, close-location, volume-confirmation. Formula: I(close_{t-2} > R) * I(close_{t-1} >= R) * I(close_t >= R) * (close_t / R - 1) * close_loc_{t-2} * I(vol_{t-2} > median20_{t-2}), R = max(high_{t-22..t-3}) """ df_copy = df.copy() resistance = df_copy["high"].shift(3).rolling(20, min_periods=20).max() breakout = (df_copy["close"].shift(2) > resistance).astype(float) hold1 = (df_copy["close"].shift(1) >= resistance).astype(float) hold2 = (df_copy["close"] >= resistance).astype(float) confirmed = breakout * hold1 * hold2 close_loc = ((df_copy["close"] - df_copy["low"]) / (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).replace(0.0, np.nan)).fillna(0.5) volume_confirm = (df_copy["volume"].shift(2) > df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).median().shift(2)).astype(float) hold_dist = ((df_copy["close"] - resistance) / resistance.replace(0.0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0) factor = confirmed * hold_dist * close_loc.shift(2) * volume_confirm "kw">class="kw">return factor.rename("factor_breakout_hold_confirmation_20d_refined")
